summary:
plan.md lays out eight 16×20 plots on one street. Every ground floor sits at y1, reached from a flush walk by a 2-cell slab ramp onto a level porch deck, and the same hedge runs along each back. Each house has its own chimney position, all inside the plot. No roof was dry-run and nothing was rendered.
Each house is told apart by its catalog roof and front: Magnolia a hip roof behind a full-height columned portico with a pediment and balcony; Alhambra a stepped brick-coped parapet over a three-arch arcade; Vallonia a side gable sweeping over a porch on stone piers.
Puritan has a gambrel with a long shed dormer, Cornell a cube with a hipped dormer, Stanford a Cape with two dormers and a central chimney, Winona a small front gable, and the Craftsman shingle over clapboard under wide braced eaves. Each has its own wall and roof colours from the same era. Eight Sears kit houses on 16-wide plots, each identified by roof form, porch and window rhythm, sharing one lawn, hedge and slab-ramp way in so the row reads as one street.
The build is six trade-cut parts: two masonry shells (plots 0-3, 4-7), roofs, porches and facade ornament, glazing and fittings, and chimneys with grounds.
Each house has 3-4 whole beds, living room, kitchen with stove, dining table and a lit brick hearth.

parts.name: shell west (plots 0-3)
parts.scope: Foundations, walls, floors y1/y5(/y9), partitions, stair holes + flight() and every opening left air for Magnolia, Alhambra, Vallonia, Puritan; clapboardWall(), cased arches; leave reserved cells.

parts.name: shell east (plots 4-7)
parts.scope: Same for Cornell, Stanford, Winona, Craftsman (lap siding lower, shingle upper, birch/dark_oak skirt); gable and kneewall infill; flight() stairs.

parts.name: roofs
parts.scope: roof.json per plot per plan ROOFS (hip, gable, gambrel, side-gable cottage, front gable), trusses, keep chimney cells, dormers; dry-run clean; porch roofs and pediments by hand.

parts.name: porches and facade ornament
parts.scope: portico(), balcony(), shapedParapet(), arcadeBay(), taperedPier(), kneeBrace(), rafterTails(), pedimentPorch(), squarePorch(), doorHood(), gablePorch(), decks.

parts.name: glazing, doors, shutters
parts.scope: windowPair/windowTriple, doorSet incl. double doors and sidelights, shutterPair, windowBox on every opening listed in OPENINGS.

parts.name: chimneys, walks and grounds
parts.scope: chimneyStack() per plan calls after roofs, accessRamp() for each plot, lawn(), hedge(), foundationPlanting(), porchLantern(), street strip; verify approach and fit.

recruit.why: Brick plinths, mud-brick and stucco shells, arcade arches, stone porch piers and parapet coping.
Hip, gambrel, front/side gable and shed roofs with dormers, verge and overhang from the roof tool.
Porch posts, brackets, knee braces, columns, pediments and balconies.
Paired windows, sidelit doors, shutters and window boxes.
Exterior brick chimneys with lit campfire hearths and walled flues.
Lawns, hedges, accessible slab ramps and foundation planting.
Flights with flush top steps in each house.
Beds, kitchens, dining and light in every room.
